assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The patient has a diagnosis of atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10).
The patient has a diagnosis of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0).
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current rate-control management.
The service is medically necessary to address the specific clinical need to evaluate the patient's condition as described in the indication note.
